output:
★★★★☆

Used Kilbarrack Van Co for a move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra on Saturday 17 October. Overall I’d use them again, and they were the best value I found, but there were a couple of things worth mentioning if you’re booking a move.

I was quoted €340 for two lads and the van for up to four hours. Other quotes I’d got were €450 upwards, so it was a decent difference. It was a two-bed flat, though mostly my stuff being moved, and the new place is a fourth-floor walk-up with no lift. The whole job took about three and a half hours, which I thought was good going with those stairs.

The main issue on the day was the start time. They were booked for 9am and arrived at 10.30. Dessie did text at 8.40 to say the previous job had overrun, so I wasn’t left wondering whether they were coming, but I was still sitting on boxes with a cold coffee for longer than planned. It wasn’t a disaster for me, but if you’ve a tight handover time with a landlord, that sort of delay could be awkward. To be fair, Dessie knocked €40 off afterwards without me asking, which I appreciated.

Once they got going, there was plenty to be happy with. The couch wouldn’t get around the turn on the third floor and I was wondering how we were going to manage it. One of the lads had an Allen key in his pocket, took the legs off and got it straight through. Very glad of someone knowing what to do at that point, rather than trying to force it around the corner.

They also put the bed back together without being asked and took away a flat-pack shelf I didn’t want. Those are the things you really appreciate when you’ve moved everything up four flights and still have the unpacking ahead of you.

The other downside was that the brass base of my floor lamp got chipped. Everything else was wrapped in blankets, but the lamp wasn’t. It was my nanny’s, so I was a bit gutted about that. I’d definitely flag anything sentimental or delicate beforehand and make sure it’s wrapped before it goes into the van. Wrap the lamps, lads.

Four stars feels fair to me. Good value, capable lads and helpful with more than just carrying boxes, but the lateness and the damage are why it’s not five. I’d book them again, though I’d leave some breathing room on the timing and pay closer attention to how the delicate bits are protected.
